summary: Expanded the universe around the transmission-line hardware/fittings node using a two-lane Serenity funnel. The cleanest underfollowed direct exposure is Preformed Line Products, a small-cap manufacturer of products used in transmission, distribution, communications, and utility asset inspection. Hubbell is the obvious diversified reference competitor with power utility line-construction hardware but less pure exposure. Quanta Services and MYR Group are included as direct customer/installation-demand anchors rather than hardware manufacturers, because hardware procurement and qualified product availability should precede or enable their transmission construction work.
